_note: Tool definitions actually transmitted by a real agent run at an OpenAI Chat Completions boundary. Only name/description/parameters (and strict when present). No headers, auth material, or message content.

process_kill.description: Kill a managed background process. Provide exactly one of process_id or name. Omit the other field; do not use an empty string as a placeholder.

name.description: Optional unique managed process name. Provide exactly one of process_id or name; omit process_id when using name.

process_id.description: Optional managed process id returned by process_start or process_list. Provide exactly one of process_id or name; omit name when using process_id.

process_read.description: Read buffered stdout and stderr from a managed background process. Provide exactly one of process_id or name. Omit the other field; do not use an empty string as a placeholder.

cursor.description: Optional output cursor returned by a previous process_read call.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to return from each stream. Defaults to 64 KiB.
